name: Exp_XWPR_Histogram_Vol
summary: This EA trades based on the XWPR histogram indicator, which is an enhanced Williams' Percent Range displayed as a histogram around a zero line. Volume confirmation is required before entry, ensuring that momentum signals are supported by actual market participation. The EA opens positions when the WPR histogram crosses the zero line and volume conditions are met.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XWPR直方图指标进行交易，该指标是增强版的威廉百分比范围指标，以零线为中心的直方图形式展示。入场需要成交量确认，确保动量信号有实际市场参与支撑。当WPR直方图穿越零线且满足成交量条件时，EA开仓交易。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于威廉百分比范围(WPR)指标的直方图模式，将传统的超买超卖指标转换为以零线为中心的动量直方图，使趋势判断更加直观。入场条件为：XWPR直方图从负值区域上穿零线时做多，从正值区域下穿零线时做空，同时要求成交量指标确认趋势的可靠性。出场条件依赖反向信号的出现，即直方图反向穿越零线时平仓，或通过止损/止盈参数控制风险。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，由用户通过InpLot参数设定，未包含动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈参数，但缺乏整体账户风险控制机制如最大回撤限制或账户权益保护。该策略的核心优势在于结合动量与成交量双重过滤，能有效过滤虚假突破信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Williams Percent Range (WPR) indicator displayed in histogram mode, transforming the traditional overbought/oversold oscillator into a zero-centered momentum histogram for more intuitive trend identification. Entry conditions require the XWPR histogram to cross above the zero line from negative territory for long positions, and below the zero line from positive territory for short positions, with volume confirmation mandatory to validate the momentum signal. Exit conditions rely on the appearance of a reverse signal, meaning positions are closed when the histogram crosses the zero line in the opposite direction, or through user-configured stop-loss and take-profit parameters. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach controlled by the InpLot parameter, without any dynamic lot sizing based on account equity or risk percentage. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters but lacks comprehensive account-level risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits, equity protection, or trailing stop mechanisms. The core strength of this strategy lies in combining momentum and volume dual filtering, which effectively reduces false breakout signals that plague single-indicator systems.

parameters.name: InpStopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: InpTakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

pros: 动量与成交量双重过滤机制，有效减少虚假信号
直方图模式使WPR信号更直观，零线穿越逻辑清晰
系统化执行无情感干扰，入场出场规则明确
成交量确认增加了信号的可靠性，避免低流动性市场的误导
参数设计简洁，用户可快速理解并调整
pros_en: Dual momentum and volume filtering effectively reduces false signals
Histogram mode makes WPR signals more intuitive with clear zero-line crossover logic
Systematic execution without emotional interference, clear entry and exit rules
Volume confirmation increases signal reliability, avoiding misleading signals in low-liquidity markets
Simple parameter design allows users to quickly understand and adjust settings
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态风险管理，无法根据账户规模自动调整
止损和止盈默认值为0，新手可能忽略设置导致无限风险
单一指标策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号
缺乏移动止损机制，盈利头寸可能大幅回吐
没有账户级别的风险控制如最大持仓限制或回撤保护
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic risk management, cannot auto-adjust based on account size
Stop-loss and take-profit default to 0, beginners may overlook setting them leading to unlimited risk
Single-indicator strategy prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets
No trailing stop mechanism, profitable positions may give back significant gains
No account-level risk controls such as maximum position limits or drawdown protection
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户权益和ATR自动调整手数
添加移动止损和保本止损功能，保护已获利润
增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX），在震荡市中减少交易频率
实现多时间周期确认机制，提高信号可靠性
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account equity and ATR for adaptive risk management
Implement trailing stop and break-even functionality to protect accumulated profits
Add market regime filter (e.g., ADX) to reduce trading frequency in ranging markets
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism to improve signal reliability

risk_points: 止损和止盈默认值为零，未设置时风险敞口无限
固定手数不考虑账户规模，小账户可能过度杠杆
单一动量指标在横盘市中频繁交易可能导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Stop-loss and take-profit default to zero, unlimited risk exposure when not set
Fixed lot sizing ignores account size, small accounts may be over-leveraged
Single momentum indicator in sideways markets may cause consecutive losses from frequent trading
